MGMT at Lupo's Heartbreak Hotel

  • Apr 30, 2013
  • Providence, Rhode Island

MGMT on their Spring 2013 tour, previewing material from the self-titled album (released that June).

One of the worst shows I’ve been to. The crowd chanted their singles and they refused to play them. Came off as a bunch of pricks.
